scope: Automatic v60c awake SAVE after cold capture; target DWT durations only, no complete cold-cycle energy claim
notes: Automatic entry has nonce zero and is separate from upcoming explicit-nonce same-frame RAM SAVE repetitions.
COMPLETE includes post-cache-clean uncached frame validation; legacy total excludes that final validation.
Encode includes callback time; subtracting callback estimates encoder-side time for this implementation.
Driver ready_cycles overlaps command/transfer scopes and must not be added to write_cycles or described as pure card programming time.
The nominal one-bit payload wire time excludes command framing, CRC, response and card busy; it is a lower bound, not a four-bit speed prediction.
Final bytewise PNG verification is pending separately; the reported file completion and matching RAW fingerprint are not substituted for that check.
The awake current plateau is not an observable SAVE-completion boundary.
